appMenu.description: macOS application menu title. The product name; keep it as is.

about.description: macOS app menu item that opens the about box. {{name}} is the product name.

services.description: macOS app menu submenu with system services.

hide.description: macOS app menu item that hides the app. {{name}} is the product name.

hideOthers.description: macOS app menu item that hides every other app.

showAll.description: macOS app menu item that shows every hidden app.

quit.description: Menu item that quits the app. {{name}} is the product name.

newWindow.description: Command that opens a new, empty fiddle window.

reload.description: Command that reloads the current window's view. Unsaved text is kept.

toggleDevTools.description: Command that opens or closes Chromium's developer tools for the app window.

toggleFullScreen.description: View menu item that enters or leaves full screen.

zoom.description: macOS Window menu item that zooms the window.

close.description: Window menu item that closes the focused window.

openLinkMessage.message: Open this link in your browser?
openLinkMessage.description: Confirmation dialog shown before a link opens in the default browser. The URL is shown below it.

openLink.description: Button in the open-link confirmation dialog that opens the link.

cancel.description: Button that dismisses a dialog without doing anything.
